svg.title: Oddies animation production storyboard
svg.text: Oddies / a little life in every moment.
PRODUCTION STORYBOARD · SHARED FACE / FOUR FUTURES · 5.2 SECOND INTERACTION
Lead with lips; then add a nod.
A / E. Quiet hands, soft emphasis.
Close in 110 ms, return to idle.
BLINKS 3–6 s APART / HEAD ±1.5° / BREATH 4–6 s / MOUTH CLOSES DURING PAUSES
